argv: cd "$1" || exit 2; bash corpus/claim-ledger.sh --selftest >"$2/a.out" 2>"$2/a.err"; ra=$?; bash corpus/claim-ledger.sh --selftest >"$2/b.out" 2>"$2/b.err"; rb=$?; cmp "$2/a.out" "$2/b.out" && echo "stdout byte-identical"; cmp "$2/a.err" "$2/b.err" && echo "stderr byte-identical"; sha256sum "$2/a.out" "$2/b.out" "$2/a.err" "$2/b.err"; echo "rc=$ra/$rb"; tail -1 "$2/a.out"
